requirementValidation.heading: Provider and Worker Responsibilities
requirementValidation.countedContent: The provider is responsible for ensuring that all supports are delivered in a safe and respectful manner. Workers must adhere to the agreed support plans and communicate any changes or concerns promptly.

requirementValidation.heading: Participant, Representative and Support-Network Responsibilities
requirementValidation.countedContent: The participant and their representative are responsible for communicating their needs and preferences. They must also engage in the planning and review processes.

requirementValidation.text: Health, medication, behaviour support and restrictive-practice boundaries
requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Health, medication, behaviour support and restrictive-practice boundaries
requirementValidation.heading: Health, Medication, Behaviour Support and Restrictive-Practice Boundaries
requirementValidation.countedContent: Health and medication management must be conducted by qualified professionals. Behaviour support plans must be adhered to, and any restrictive practices must be documented and justified.

requirementValidation.text: Risk, safety, incident and escalation arrangements
requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Risk, safety, incident and escalation arrangements
requirementValidation.heading: Risk, Safety, Incident and Escalation Arrangements
requirementValidation.countedContent: Risk management strategies must be in place, including emergency contact details and incident reporting procedures. Escalation pathways must be clearly defined.

requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Community participation and service-delivery coordination
requirementValidation.heading: Community Participation and Service-Delivery Coordination
requirementValidation.countedContent: Community participation goals must be outlined, with clear responsibilities for coordination and support delivery. Community Participation Goals: [COMMUNITY_PARTICIPATION_GOALS] Coordination Responsibilities: [COORDINATION_RESPONSIBILITIES] Service Delivery Support: [SERVICE_DELIVERY_SUPPORT]

requirementValidation.text: Review, updates, consent and sign-off provisions
requirementValidation.target: Supervision, check-in and sign-off checklist section
requirementValidation.heading: Review, Updates, Consent and Sign-off Provisions
requirementValidation.countedContent: Review Date: [REVIEW_DATE] The care plan must be reviewed regularly to ensure it meets the participant's needs. Consent for the plan must be obtained from the participant and their representative. Sign-off: [SIGN_OFF]
